items.label: The 5,500-Year Timeline & the Heavens at Yeshua’s Crucifixion
Where Are We in This Timeline? Daniel’s Seventy Sevens & the End of the Age

notes:
This teaching continues from 1 Corinthians 15 and Revelation 20 on the order of the resurrections, then shifts into a detailed examination of the 5,500-year timeline from Creation to Yeshua. Drawing from the Acts of Pilate, the First Book of Adam and Eve, and the Book of Enoch, it calculates generations using Psalm 90:10 and compares the Septuagint with the Masoretic Text. The study includes extensive Stellarium analysis of the crucifixion on April 8, 27 AD, highlighting celestial signs that align with Golgotha (the Place of the Skull / Goliath’s head), the Shepherd constellation, and the cutting off of the right arm, while also addressing calendar systems and the timing of Passover.

A comprehensive visual timeline from Creation through Yeshua’s ministry and into the Second Coming, examining premillennial, millennial, and post-millennial views. It addresses Yeshua’s statements that some standing with Him would not taste death before seeing the Kingdom come in power, the preaching of the Gospel to all nations within that generation, and the roughly 40-year span of the Book of Acts. This focuses heavily on Daniel’s Seventy Sevens (Daniel 9:24-27), calculating the 483 years from the decree in 457 BC to Yeshua’s crucifixion, and concludes with the Abomination of Desolation and the pressing question of where we stand in the prophetic timeline.
